text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ughhh, you've gotta be kidding...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh... what a coincidence. Are you here
to see the
German art exhibition as well?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, like... kinda? My class has to write
a report
on it, but fancy old-fashioned
art stuff is like
waaay over my head.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go through the
exhibition
together, then? I'm no expert,
but I do know a
little about German art.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh... just two randos, a bazillion feet
apart
'cause they're... what, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Lovers. The man on the one side is the
artist
himself, while the lady on the
other end is a
noblewoman.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? If they're a thing, why are they
so far
away? Or what, did their
relationship get all stale
or something?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! That's an interesting
interpretation, but they're actually
trying to hide their relationship here.
The two belonged to very different social
classes, you see.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So?! Who even thinks like that
anymore?! If they
love each other, they
love each other!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well, back when this was painted, there
was far less acceptance for romance
outside one's social standing. The couple
in the painting were never able to have a
true relationship, and ultimately 
separated.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But that's so sad! Even if they couldn't
be together in public, couldn't they have
stayed
together on priv? Like dude, just
message her!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's an intriguing thought... But I
suppose people of the time period did
exchange love letters and other such
clandestine
correspondence.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh... right. They had to ship like actual
paper letters back then, huh? Sorry I'm
so off base, but like I genuinely can't
imagine not being able to just DM the
girl on Umasta. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. You've
made some
excellent observations about
the pair's
expressions and situation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You noticed the forced distance
between them, empathized with their
story, and brought a unique, modern
Japanese perspective to their
romance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please, nurture and treasure that lovely

astuteness of yours, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, uh... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Flash, you are the GOAT! I'm totally
gonna nail
this report, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm simply glad I could help. On another
note... Jordan, I noticed that you were
leaning about
five degrees to the left as
you walked just now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How can you even tell that?! But yeah,
these
shoes are new, so I'm lowkey kinda
getting a
blister.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm so sorry,
I didn't realize. I've got a little
first aid kit on me, so let's get
you over to that bench and treat it
straightaway.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! It's just a blister! You don't have
to "treat
it" or anything... I-I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For now, perhaps, but it will only get
worse if we ignore it. Please, take my
hand, and try not to put
weight on the
sore foot. I'll help you over.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Flash, it's fine, I swear! I... I can walk over myself, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Flash?! Why'd you lay your handkerchief
down on
the bench? Don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well, it wouldn't do to get your nice
clothes all
dirty, would it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now, let me have a look at your foot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! F-FLASH! Ohhh my gosh, stop, you don't have to do that! Flash, please, this is so... Aah!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Um... So like, today was fun. Thanks.
And uh,
sorry for all the chaos...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know you had that kind of a side
to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hm? "That kind of a side?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... nothing. But let's go out again
sometime!
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm strolling through campus when I spot
Eishin
Flash, deep in thought with a
worried expression.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Yes, thank you. I was just a little
confused
about something someone said
to me.
choice_data_list: What's the matter? Something on yo...
What's the matter? Something on yo...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...And so I wasn't entirely sure what she
meant by
"that kind of a side."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like her friend was a bit
flustered experiencing Eishin Flash's
doting side for the first time, but was
happy she got to know her better. I
reassure Eishin Flash of that, and...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Seeing a new side of me... made her feel
like
we've gotten closer? So that's what
it was...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash is lost in thought again—this
time
with an embarrassed look.
